subject: POC: Prompt dataset + eval plan (AcmeHealth)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@acmehealth.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: POC: Prompt dataset + eval plan (AcmeHealth)

Thanks again for the call this morning — great discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same plan for the POC. Please reply/confirm and attach the prompt set + any example logs when you’re ready.

Recap (what we heard):
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for AcmeHealth document summarization + triage assistant for clinical ops.
- Key success criteria: 1) 90%+ accuracy on intent classification for triage; 2) average summary ROUGE-L >= 0.45 on the sample set; 3) end-to-end latency <= 250ms p50 on typical 2k-token requests.

Proposed evaluation plan:
1) You provide: representative prompt set (user queries + expected outputs) and a ~1k sample of anonymized logs (or synthetic equivalent)
2) Redwood: run prompt set against 3 model variants, produce eval metrics (classification precision/recall, ROUGE, calibration), and produce sample outputs for manual review
3) Joint review: align on quality thresholds and failure modes; prioritize prompts for mitigation (prompt engineering / system prompt / templates)

Timeline (proposed):
- 11/10: confirm dataset/formats and ownership
- 11/12: kickoff with engineering for environment provisioning (30 min)
- 11/12-11/18: Redwood runs evals and shares report
- 11/19: joint review + decision on next steps (pilot/expand)

Ownership:
- AcmeHealth: provide prompt set and logs, identify internal SME(s) for quick clarifications
- Redwood: Marissa (POC lead) + Aditya (infra) + Rishi (eval metrics)

Ask:
- Please upload the prompt CSV (columns: query, expected_output, category) and any logs to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_acme-poc or attach directly to this thread. If you have PII concerns, please send the redacted/synthetic set and we’ll sign an access agreement.

Let me know if any of the success criteria above needs adjusting. If that looks good, can you upload the prompt set by EOD 11/17 and confirm a 20–30m kickoff on 11/12?

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(415) 555-0112
